newsitem.title: FRANCE: Algeria increases minimum wage to $109 per month.
newsitem.headline: Algeria increases minimum wage to $109 per month.

text.p: Algeria's government, unions and businessmen agreed on Friday to increase monthly minimum wages in the private sector to 6,000 dinars ($109) and by 20 percent for civil servants, the official APS news agency said.
The present minimum wage is 4,000 dinars.

The wage rise in the private sector will be implemented in three stages, starting next month -- a lift to 4,800 dinars effective from May 1, to 5,400 dinars starting January 1, 1998, and to 6,000 dinars from September 1998.
The public sector increases, for which no cash figures were given, will be implemented over the same period by rises of 10 percent, five percent and five percent, APS said.

The agreement was reached after a meeting of the seventh tripartite commission presided over by Prime Minister Ahmed Ouyahia and attended by government officials and union and business representatives, the agency added.
